units: Unreal Units (UU). Locations are UT axes: x forward, y right, z UP. Convert with src/shared/map-transform.js.
edgeSourceNote: Edges are Epic's own FReachSpecs, decoded from the ULevel object of the .unr and cross-checked against every NavigationPoint's Paths[]/upstreamPaths[] arrays. Pruned specs (redundant, editor-only) are excluded.
